title: The Illustration lifecycle runs itself
description:
A Story's Illustration step: needed, candidates made, chosen, placed, with alt text and credit rules checked. When unattended the agent makes one image; when a person is choosing it may make several. A generated image carries no credit; a third-party image is always credited. A request for a figure from another agent is an Assignment.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A Story that needs an image gets candidates without a person asking.
- The step cannot close with missing alt text or a missing third-party credit.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- illustration-lifecycle.feature: a Story entering illustration gets one candidate unattended; a missing alt text keeps the step open; a third-party image without credit keeps it open.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Lifecycles that run themselves: Reference, Idea, Translation, Illustration. Slice code K4 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
